title: feat: Add CRM ecosystem integration connector schemas
body:
Adds domain-specific connector protocols to support downstream CRM app needs (Phase 3: Ecosystem & Connectivity) — payment gateways, e-signatures, communication platforms, email, accounting, HRIS, and recruiting/ATS.

## New Connector Schemas

Each extends `ConnectorSchema` with provider enums, domain-specific webhook events, object types with CRUD flags, and configuration sections:

- **`payment.zod.ts`** — Stripe, PayPal, Square, Braintree, Adyen. Payment methods, currencies, idempotency config, statement descriptors, sandbox mode.
- **`esign.zod.ts`** — DocuSign, Adobe Sign, HelloSign, PandaDoc. Envelope lifecycle, signing options, sequential signing, reminders/expiration, branding.
- **`communication.zod.ts`** — Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams. Channel mappings for deal rooms/support, CRM notification rules, bot config.
- **`email.zod.ts`** — Gmail, Outlook, Exchange. Email-to-lead, email-to-case, open/click tracking, signature injection, folder sync scope.
- **`accounting.zod.ts`** — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, FreshBooks, Sage. Invoice sync with line item mapping, chart of accounts, multi-currency, tax config, fiscal year.
- **`hris.zod.ts`** — BambooHR, Workday, ADP, Gusto, Rippling. Employee/payroll sync, org structure, PII protection (SSN/bank masking, encryption, retention).
- **`recruiting.zod.ts`** — LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, Workable. Candidate pipeline stages, interview scheduling, scorecards, GDPR/EEOC compliance.

## Pattern

All connectors follow the established `ConnectorSchema.extend()` pattern:

```typescript
export const PaymentConnectorSchema = ConnectorSchema.extend({
  type: z.literal('saas'),
  provider: PaymentProviderSchema,
  mode: PaymentModeSchema,
  supportedCurrencies: z.array(z.string()),
  objectTypes: z.array(PaymentObjectTypeSchema),
  webhookEvents: z.array(PaymentWebhookEventSchema).optional(),
  idempotencyConfig: IdempotencyConfigSchema.optional(),
  // ...
});
```

Each file includes 2 example configurations and a co-located `.test.ts` with full schema coverage. 154 new tests, 225 total integration tests passing.
